about_the_game:
FIND WORDS. SCORE POINTS. BEAT THE CLOCK.

Looxi is an addictive word-finding puzzle game that challenges your vocabulary and pattern recognition skills. With 120 carefully designed stages and an unlimited quick play mode, Looxi offers the perfect blend of casual fun and brain-teasing challenge.

GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Quick 2-Minute Rounds: Perfect for coffee breaks, commutes, or whenever you have a few minutes to spare

  • 120 Unique Stages: Progress through increasingly challenging letter arrangements

  • Quick Play Mode: Endless replayability with randomized letter grids

  • Strategic Scoring: Each letter has different point values—find the highest-scoring words to maximize your score

  • Simple Controls: Just click and drag to connect adjacent letters (horizontal, vertical, and diagonal)

In Looxi, you'll race against a 2-minute timer to find as many words as possible. Connect adjacent letters to form words of 3 or more letters, with longer and more complex words earning higher scores. Each letter has its own point value, so choosing the right words is key to achieving top scores.

Whether you have just a few minutes to play or want to challenge yourself across all 120 stages, Looxi provides the perfect word-finding experience for players of all skill levels.

Can you master all stages and claim the highest scores? Download Looxi now and put your word skills to the test!
